title: Brownlee, Lala and Emmett Hardy across the river
summary: Laine cannot recall many musicians by name; he knew of Emmett Hardy but never played with him, having led a band there long before.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Anything else you want to... I was wondering about those fellas from across the river like Brownlee. Did you know Brownlee? Norman Brownlee? He might have been after your time.

You know, some of those fellas there, as I told you, I don't remember them anymore. Don't you know? By name or even the features, the faces, you know. I don't remember them anymore. As I told you about this man, Lala, of course, he's pretty good in age now. He's great-headed. And he come up to me and he asked me, he said, I know him. I said, no, I don't. He had to explain to me who he was before I could recognize him. I know him.
Well, he had a band across the river with Emmett Hardy. Hardy? You remember Hardy?

Yes, I know Hardy. No, I never played with Hardy. He never played with me. But I had a band over there before Hardy, long, long before Hardy. Now, Hardy seemed to be a pretty good fella, pretty good kid.
